additional_info.body:
Dear Markus,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Ivalo
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
Qu2jTM
Problem Description
: QA15-16 fbk: ON and converter missing
Troubleshooting
: Please proceed with the replacement of QA15-16.
For the converter please swap with the neighbour and check if it's resolved.
If yes, then it was most likely a wiring issue
If no, then is the problem in the same converter?
​​​​​​​
​​​​​​​If yes, then please replace it.
If no, then please check the CAN communication cables, they should have 60ohm from H to L, if it's different then there might be a problem with the wirings.
​​​​​​​Possible loose connector:
​​​​​​​
For future reference, your case number is
0436153
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
